plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there is an audio recording of a deathbed confession by Jacqu Cornon, a French aerospace executive, made around 2009. In it, Michels says, Cornon states he personally witnessed successful experiments by a researcher named Brown inside a vacuum chamber, a sealed space with the air pumped out, in Paris in 1956, and Michels also points to a 12 page report on that test. If true, it would mean a kind of propulsion that works without air, which the host links to antigravity, was shown to work decades ago.
